info.title: ZoneMinder API (zm-php-api)
info.description:
ZoneMinder's API v2 (`/zm/api`, apiversion 2.0), as answered by zm-php-api: the same URLs, status
codes, bodies and errors as ZoneMinder's CakePHP API, without CakePHP.

## URLs

- `.json` at the end of a path picks JSON (the default), `.xml` picks XML. The
  extension goes on the last segment: `monitors/1.json`, `host/daemonCheck/zmc.json`.
- Plain resources take the REST forms: `GET monitors.json` (list), `POST monitors.json`
  (add), `GET|PUT|POST|DELETE monitors/<id>.json` (view, edit, edit, delete).
- Every controller also answers `<controller>/<action>[/<arg>...].json`, which is the
  only way to reach actions such as `monitors/alarm` or `events/consoleEvents`.
  The action forms of the CRUD actions (`monitors/view/1.json`, `monitors/edit/1.json`)
  work too; this document lists the REST forms where they exist.
- `Name:value` path segments are named arguments: filters on index actions
  (`events/index/MonitorId:1.json`) and the arguments of `monitors/alarm` and
  `monitors/daemonStatus`. Don't percent-encode the `/` between filters.

## Authentication

Log in with `POST host/login.json` (`user` and `pass`, or `username` and `password`,
as form fields) for an access and a refresh token. Send the access token as
`token=` or in an `Authorization: Bearer` header; renew it with
`POST host/login.json` and `token=<refresh token>`. With authentication off
(ZM_OPT_USE_AUTH), every request is allowed.

## Permissions and errors

Each operation lists the permissions it needs (`Needs:`). Per-monitor restrictions
apply on top: rows on a monitor the user may not view are left out of lists and
answer 401 or 404 on their own. Errors answer with the `Error` body.

## PHP's empty arrays

An object with no keys (an empty list of rows keyed by id, an empty `Monitor_Status`)
is sent as `[]`, as PHP serialises an empty array. Clients should accept `[]`
wherever an object is documented.

tags.name: Camera Models
tags.description: /camera_models: camera models. Reached only as camera_models/<action>/...; the cameramodels resource name has never had a controller.

tags.name: Configs
tags.description:
/configs: the options of Options. Reading needs System=View, changing System=Edit.

An option is addressed by its Name (configs/ZM_WEB_EVENTS_PER_PAGE) or its Id. The value answered is the one in effect, which zm.conf and conf.d may override. Secrets (private options, the database credentials) are answered with an empty Value.

tags.name: Controls
tags.description: /controls: PTZ control definitions, read-only. They are edited under Options, so reading them needs System=View.

tags.name: Encoder Templates
tags.description: /encoder_templates: encoder parameter presets. Anyone may read; changes need System=Edit. ?Encoder=<name> limits the list to one encoder. A save that fails validation answers 422 {"message": "Error", "errors": {field: [messages]}}.

tags.name: Event Data
tags.description: /event_data: data attached to events. Needs Events=View, and rows are visible only with their monitor; changes need Events=Edit, edit rights on the event and access to the monitor (also the event and monitor a row is moved to).

tags.name: Events
tags.description: /events: recorded events. Needs Events=View, and an event is visible only to users who may view its monitor; changes need Events=Edit and edit rights on the monitor (archiving needs only view rights, see archive()).

tags.name: Frames
tags.description:
/frames: the frames of events. Needs Events=View, and a frame is visible only with its event's monitor; changes need Events=Edit and edit rights on the event.

A frame is addressed by event and frame number: frames/view/<EventId>/<FrameId> (also edit/ and delete/). frames/<id> takes one number, so it finds no frame.

1.38: Frames also has its own key, Id (master c4ef3fdd6 dropped it), and 1.38's CakePHP API addressed frames by it: frames/<Id>, frames/view/<Id>, edit/ and delete/. There, one number is that Id (frame()), and writes go by it.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description:
/groups: monitor groups and their members. Needs Groups=View; changes need Groups=Edit. Membership decides per-monitor access, so changing a group's members (or moving the group, or deleting it) also needs edit rights on every monitor that moves. Monitors the user may not view are left out of member lists.

Members are sent as Group[MonitorIds]=1,2,3 or Monitor[]=1&Monitor[]=2.

tags.name: Logs
tags.description:
/logs: ZoneMinder's log. Needs System=View; writing needs System=Edit (adding also works for anyone when ZM_LOG_INJECT is on). Entries are addressed by TimeKey: logs/view/<TimeKey>.

The index is paged with ?page=&limit= (100 by default), oldest first unless ?sort=&direction= say otherwise: {"logs": [...], "pagination": {...}}.

tags.name: Manufacturers
tags.description: /manufacturers: camera manufacturers. Anyone may read; changes need System=Edit.

tags.name: Monitors
tags.description:
/monitors: monitors, and their daemons and alarms.

Each monitor is visible only to users who may view it (Monitors permission and the per-monitor and group ACLs); changes need edit rights on it. Creating needs System=Edit or Monitors=Create, deleting System=Edit. Deleting soft-deletes, as the console does: the row stays with Deleted=1, events kept.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: /notifications: push-notification registrations of client devices. Each user manages their own; System=Edit manages everyone's. Registering a Token that is already registered updates that registration.

tags.name: Pages
tags.description: /pages: static pages. The API has none, so this answers 404 (403 for a path with . or ..), as the CakePHP scaffold it replaces did. /api/ itself redirects to /api/pages/home.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: /roles: user roles. Needs System=View; changes need System=Edit. A role's view lists its group and monitor permissions and its users.

tags.name: Server Stats
tags.description: /server_stats: load samples, oldest first. Anyone may read; changes need System=Edit.

tags.name: Servers
tags.description: /servers: the servers of a multi-server install. Anyone may read; changes need System=Edit.

tags.name: Snapshots
tags.description: /snapshots: named sets of events. Needs Snapshots=View; changes need Snapshots=Edit, and a snapshot can only include events the user may view. Events on monitors the user may not view are left out of every answer. Events are added with Snapshot[EventIds]=1,2 or Event[]=1&Event[]=2.

tags.name: States
tags.description: /states: run states, and switching ZoneMinder between them. Needs System=View; changes (and states/change) need System=Edit.

tags.name: Storage
tags.description: /storage: storage areas, with their disk usage. Needs System=View; changes need System=Edit. Reached as storage/<action>/... (storage/<id> is not routed).

tags.name: Tags
tags.description:
/tags: event tags. Needs Events=View; creating, changing and deleting tags needs Events=Edit, and only events the user may view can be tagged.

tags/index/Events.Id:<id>[,<id>...] lists the tags of those events, each with the event it is on (Events_Tags.EventId), limited to the monitors the user may view. Events are tagged with Tag[EventIds]=1,2 or Event[]=1&Event[]=2.

tags.name: User Preference
tags.description: /user_preference: a user's saved settings (the montage layout, ...). A preference belongs to the user who set it: everyone manages their own, and System=Edit manages everyone's.

tags.name: Users
tags.description:
/users: user accounts. Needs System=View; changes need System=Edit. With ZM_USER_SELF_EDIT on, a user may also view and edit their own account whatever their System permission, but change only what the web UI lets them change about themselves (SELF_EDITABLE, includes/actions/user.php), never their permissions. Password hashes are never answered.

The index is paged with users/index/page:N/limit:M: {"users": [...], "pagination": {...}}.

tags.name: Zone Presets
tags.description: /zone_presets: zone templates, shared by all monitors. Anyone may read; changes are system configuration and need System=Edit. Reached as zone_presets/<action>/... (the zonepresets resource name has no controller).

tags.name: Zones
tags.description: /zones: motion detection zones. Needs Monitors=View, and each zone is visible only with its monitor; changes need Monitors=Edit and edit rights on the monitor (and on the monitor a zone is moved to).

get.description:
The events the user may view: {"events": [...], "pagination": {...}}.

Filters are named arguments (events/index/MonitorId:3/StartDateTime >=:...), or, without any, query parameters (events?MonitorId=3). Besides the columns: - DateTime <op>:<time> matches events running at that time: with >=/>, events
    that had not ended by then; with </<=, events that had started by then.

- GroupId:<id>, the events of a group's monitors (each event then lists Group). - TagId:<ids>, Tag:<name> or Tags:<name>, the events carrying those tags. - StartTime/EndTime are the old names of StartDateTime/EndDateTime.

Paged with ?limit=&page= (20 a page by default, at most 100); without either, all matching events. ?sort=&direction= order the list.

Needs: Events View.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to answer (from 1). A page past the last is a 404.
